cleanRoomBoundary.statement: Only high-level category, massing, palette, appendage, material, effect, and presentation cues were retained from the cited sources. No source geometry, texture layout, pixel placement, costume, face, pose, or distinctive arrangement was copied.
cleanRoomBoundary.implementationBoundary: Each owned target remains a direct independent EntityModel with its own hierarchy, pivots, UV layout, animation code, texture atlas, extractor, and tests. No shared creature rig, geometry helper, player model, or skin-on-player construction is permitted.

MANIFEST/DREAD unfurls mantle, exposes cold vacancy, and reaches; explicitly no strike/damage/weapon motion.
WARN/DEFEND crosses ward palms around the golden core and cants halos forward.
PETITION/COOLDOWN bows, shelters the heart, and aligns memory motes.
ANSWER/STRIKE presents the recorded leading pose and two offset replay shells.
